QuestInfo.name: [Theme Dungeon] Ellinel Fairy Academy
QuestInfo.0:
Feng asked Lan Yi, a Beggar Guild member in Victoria, for a job that could provide good combat experience, save some lives, and make the Xuanshan School look good in order to spread its name.
Talk to Lan Yi to learn more about what's going on in the Ellinel Fairy Academy.
QuestInfo.1:
Maple World was full of beings different from those in Jianghu. A lot more than you had initially thought! Of them, Fairies are some of the most cautious around humans, which lead to the imprisonment of a human magician who dared to step foot into the Ellinel Fairy Academy.
Lan Yi asked you to stop the incident from escalating, as it could risk the already fragile relationship between Fairies and humankind.

First go to #m101030000# and talk to #p1040002# to find out a way to enter the land of Fairies.
